[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e5afc8d305d607027e416b0f8da008468f0101f8e7922753390ece9c021c09d.png] 

Given, ∠BAC = 40°

⇒ ∠ACB = 90° [angle in a semicircle is 90]

In ΔACB

⇒ ∠ACB + ∠CBA + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ ∠CBA = 180° – 90° – 40° = 50°

⇒ ∠DCA = ∠CAB = 40° [Alternate interior angle]

⇒ ∠DCA = ∠ABD = 40° and ∠CAD = ∠DBC

∵ Two inscribed angles forming the same arc or forming two equal arcs are equal.

⇒ ∠CBA = ∠DBC + ∠ABD

⇒ 50° = ∠DBC + 40°

⇒ ∠DBC = 50° – 40° = 10°

⇒ ∠CAD = ∠DBC = 10°

A train without stoppage travels with an average speed of 50 km/h, and with stoppage, it travels with an average speed of 40 km/h. For how many minutes does the train stop on an average per hour?
questions.solution:
Without stoppage average speed = 50 km/h

With stoppages average speed = 40 km/h

As we know,

Time of rest per hour equal to the difference in average speed divided by the speed without stoppage.

Required time = [(50 – 40)/50] × 60 = 12

So, A train stops on an average 12 minute/hr

questions.question: If a + b + c = 13 and ab + bc + ca = 54, then a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc is equal to:

As we know,

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = (a + b + c) [(a + b + c)² – 3(ab + bc + ca)]

⇒ 13 [13² – 3 × 54]

⇒ 13 (169 – 162)

questions.question: If sec 4θ = cosec (θ + 20°), then θ is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 sec 4θ = cosec (θ + 20°)

**Calculation:**

sec 4θ = cosec (θ + 20°)

⇒ sec4θ = sec [90° – (θ + 20°)]

⇒ 4θ = 90° – θ – 20°

⇒ 5θ = 70°

⇒ θ = 14°

So, the value of θ is 14°

questions.question: The average marks of 40 students was found to be 68. If the marks of two students were incorrectly entered as 48 and 64 instead of 84 and 46 respectively, then what is the correct average?
questions.solution:
Average marks of 40 students = 68

Sum of marks of 40 students = 68 × 40 = 2720

According to the question

Correct sum of marks of 40 students = 2720 – 48 – 64 + 84 + 46 = 2738

Correct average marks of 40 students = 2738/40 = 68.45

**Short trick: **

⇒ 68 + [(84 + 46 – 48 – 64)/40]

⇒ 68 + [18/40]

⇒ 68.45

questions.question: The price of sugar is increased by 20%. A person wants to increase his expenditure by 8% only. By what percent should he decrease his consumption?
questions.solution:
Let the initial price of sugar be 100x.

Price of sugar after increased = 100x × [120/100] = 120x

Person wants his expenditure increase by 8% only, so his expenditure should be = 100x × [108/100] = 108x

∴ Required percentage = (120x – 108x)/120 × 100 = 10%

questions.question: The difference between the compound interest and simple interest on Rs. X at 8% per annum for 2 years is Rs. 19.20. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The difference between the compound interest and simple interest on Rs. X at 8% per annum for 2 years is Rs. 19.20

**Formula used:**

Difference between the compound interest and simple interest for 2 years = PR²/100 × 100

**Calculation:**

P × 8 × 8 /100 × 100 = 19.20

⇒ P = 3000

**∴ Value of X is Rs 3000.**

questions.question: ∆ABC ~ ∆RQP and AB = 4 cm, BC = 6 cm and AC = 5 cm. If ar (∆ABC) : ar (∆PQR) = 9 : 4, Then PQ is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc871d9000c8918e2c0efffb13c6bc0dd08f35dff6a5345be12de68568c5d3fa.png] 

Given, AB = 4 cm, BC = 6 cm, AC = 5 cm

If ΔABC ~ ΔRQP

⇒ ar (ΔABC)/ar (ΔPQR) = BC² / PQ²

⇒ 9/4 = 6²/PQ²

⇒ 9/4 = 36/PQ²

⇒ PQ² = (36 × 4)/9 = 4 × 4

⇒ PQ = 4

questions.question: Two articles are sold for Rs. 9,720 each. On one, the seller gains 8% and on the other, he loses 10%. What is his overall gain or loss?
questions.solution:
Given:

Selling Price of two articles = Rs 9720 each.

On one article, gain = 8%

On other article, loss = 10%

**Calculation:**

SP of each article = Rs. 9720

CP of first article = 9720 × [100/108] = 9000

CP of second article = 9720 × [100/90] = 10800

Total SP of both article = 9720 × 2 = 19440

Total CP of both article = 90000 + 10800 = 19800

Total loss = 19800 – 19440 = 360

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** Ratio of CP to SP of first article = 25 : 27

Ratio of CP to SP of second article = 10 : 9 ---- (1) × 3

Multiply by 3 in equation (1)

New ratio of CP to SP of second article = 30 : 27

⇒ 54 unit = 2 × 9720

⇒ 1 unit = 36

A is 40% more efficient than B and C is 20% less efficient than B. Working together, they can finish a work is 5 days. In how many days will A alone complete 70% of that work?
questions.solution:
Let efficiency of B be 100

Efficiency of A will be = 100 × [140/100] = 140

Efficiency of C will be = 100 × [80/100] = 80

Efficiency ratio of A, B and C = 140 : 100 : 80 = 7 : 5 : 4

Total work = (7 + 5 + 4) × 5 = 80

70% of total work = 80 × [70/100] = 56

70% of total work A will complete in = 56/7 = 8 days

questions.question: In the year 2014, what per cent of student were enrolled in college C in 2014? (correct to one decimal place)
questions.solution:
Total enrolled students in 2014 = 420 + 290 + 340 + 480 + 480 = 2010

Enrolled students of college C in 2014 = 340

∴ Required percentage = (340/2010) × 100 = 16.9%

questions.question: The number of students studying in college E in the year 2013 is approximately what percent of the number of students studying in college B, C and D taken together in the year 2013 (nearest to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
Number of students studying in college E in 2013 = 430

∴ Required percentage = [430/1100] × 100 = 39.09%
